4332735_15e36f48.text: young granule cells in the adult hippocampus have substantially different active and passive membrane properties from mature cells

4332735_d4e7d9a2.text: Young neurons express T-type Ca2+ channels, which are able to generate isolated calcium spikes and to amplify fast sodium action potentials

4332735_7b059509.text: Associative long-term potentiation can be induced more easily in young neurons than in mature neurons under identical conditions

4332735_cfb07191.text: newly generated neurons express unique mechanisms to facilitate synaptic plasticity, which may be important for the formation of new memories
